messages:
Elaine: quick design pass — thinking we should tighten the toolbar horizontal spacing in compact console mode. current feels a bit airy when there are 3+ actions. wondering if we should collapse the gap token from `spacing-3` -> `spacing-2` for compact.
Rob: +1 on saving horizontal real estate. do we lose affordance? are icons still tappable on touch?
Elaine: hit target stays >= 44px, this change only reduces gaps between elements, not the control size. i checked with the mock — icons still at 48px tappable area.
Sam: can you paste the token diff? also how does this interact with toast placement? toasts currently rely on toolbar padding to avoid overlap.
Elaine: here's the snippet i used for the mock:
```
--spacing-3: 12px; /* current compact */
--spacing-2: 8px;  /* proposed compact */
.toolbar { gap: var(--spacing-2); }
```
Maria: accessibility nit — with reduced gaps the visual separation between primary and secondary actions drops. can we add a subtle outline on focus or increase contrast for the primary CTA background by 3%? :thinking:
Rob: agree with maria. we should keep focus ring visible. maybe use our focus token: `focus-ring-2` with 3px thickness on compact.
Kyle: tiny copy thing — the toolbar menu label in compact becomes just "More" currently. i'd prefer "More actions" for clarity when the menu icon is hidden. small but helps discoverability.
Elaine: good call, kyle. will update copy. action: set compact gap to `spacing-2`, add `focus-ring-2` on keyboard focus, change menu label to "More actions". i'll push a new mock to Figma.
Sam: pinging design-bot for an accessibility check on contrast/focus.
design-bot: Accessibility scan queued. Results: contrast ratio for CTA background (proposed) = 4.6:1 (passes AA for text >= 14px). Focus ring visible on simulated keyboard nav. Recommendation: maintain 44px min touch target. :white_check_mark:
Maria: thanks! very small follow-up — when we reduce spacing, please spot-check table rows on narrow screens, some inline controls can feel cramped. otherwise :thumbsup:
Elaine: noted — i'll run a quick responsive check. thanks everyone, i'll update the mock and link the Figma file in this thread when done.
Rob: perfect, thanks elaine :rocket:
